What If You Never Took A Bath? The 7-Day Cartoon Experiment! — On Day 1, you smell like peanut butter! But on Day 7, tiny tickly germ monsters start throwing a wild dance party on your elbows! What really happens?
Kids science answer for "what if you never bathed kids science cartoon" with fun 2D animation by BabyBeats Rhymo!

Your skin sheds billions of microscopic cells and sweats every day; without soap and warm water, harmless micro-bugs multiply into itchy, stinky grease armies!

BabyBeats Rhymo creates kid-safe 2D science cartoons and funny educational stories every day for curious US kids and families!
